This market refers to the first 7 innings of the Arizona vs Colorado professional baseball game originally scheduled for Sep 24, 2026 at 3:10 PM EDT. If the score at the end of the first 7 innings is tied, the "Tie" strike will resolve to Yes and all team strikes will resolve to No. If this game is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled game has finished (within two days).
